title: Prove Printed.modulatedCompactSupport_isotypicQuotient_equiv_false (Theorem 4.5.2.3, p. 207)
body:
Closes #5335

Proves `Printed.modulatedCompactSupport_isotypicQuotient_equiv_false` (Theorem 4.5.2.3, (4.5.2.2), p. 207) in `RiemannMasullo/Ch04_PeriodicSchauderBases/Sec5_Printed.lean`, following its docstring. No statement is changed.

Counterexample: G = ℝ≥0ˣ with the identity module (trivial norm-one group, Haar measure on it), χ trivial, ω = 1, γ = e, B = exp([0, 1]) = [1, γ].
- A test in the supported space vanishes off B and is continuous, so its open support lies in the interior exp((0, 1)), which contains no γⁿ. Hence its homogeneous periodization is 0 at the identity class.
- The section's own profile lift (`modulatedCompactSupport_isotypicQuotient_equiv_profileLift`, private in Sec5) applied to a ContDiffBump of radius 1/2 in log coordinates gives g with periodization ∑ₙ φ(n) = 1 at the identity class.
- A linear equivalence compatible with inclusion would be onto, so some supported d has P d = P g. Evaluating at the identity class gives 0 = 1.

Additions (file only): `import all RiemannMasullo.Ch04_PeriodicSchauderBases.Sec5` (to reach that private lift and the log lemma), `import RiemannMasullo.ForMathlib.MeasureTheory.Group.Arithmetic` (`borelSpace_units_of_continuousInv₀`), and four `private theorem` helpers above the refutation (`…_false_vanish`, `…_false_supported`, `…_false_bumpSum`, `…_false_bump`). The proof was split into these to keep each one within the heartbeat limit. The module builds in about 6 s.

Checks run:
- `lake build RiemannMasullo.Ch04_PeriodicSchauderBases.Sec5_Printed`: ok. Full `lake build`: ok (18964 jobs).
- `scripts/lint.sh`: `lint: ok`.
- `scripts/signatures.sh --compare` on this module before/after (`lake env lean --run scripts/Signatures.lean`): no changed statements.
- `#print axioms Printed.modulatedCompactSupport_isotypicQuotient_equiv_false`: `propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound`. The `sorryAx` is upstream: the library's own `mem_modulatedCompactSupportSubmodule_iff`, `modulatedIsotypicPeriodization_hasSum` and `modulatedExponentialDecay_tensor_equiv` (used by the profile lift) already show it. The helper `…_false_bumpSum` is sorry-free.

Not touched: #5333 and #5334 in the same file. They need convergence arguments in the completed projective tensor product.
